findings.passage: The delay prevents this correction from acting instantaneously.
findings.check: Actor, action, condition and causal timing
findings.problem: The correction is A[E(t-tau_d)-E_OI(t)]. Only eye-position information is delayed; the current internal-command term acts immediately. The sentence can lead the reader to infer a hard delay for the whole correction, contradicting the equation and earlier explanation.
earlier_teaching_checked: content/chapters/04c-eye-circuit.md, feedback equation and following two paragraphs, especially immediate term -A E_OI(t)
findings.strongest_reasonable_reading: If this means the new retinal effect arrives with delay, it is true, but the text calls the entire difference the correction, including the present command. That scope needs explicit repair.
findings.minimal_repair: Replace the last sentence with: New changes in actual eye position enter this feedback after the delay, while the current internal-command term acts immediately.
